title: fix: reveal new child sessions in the sidebar

commit.messageHeadline: fix: reveal new child sessions in the sidebar
Merge main and preserve updated sidebar guidance
test(ui): baseline existing sidebar children before mount
test(ui): expect automatic reveal for newly discovered parents

Merged via squash.

- Prepared head SHA: [61afcff480ee54adb36f78435180e712bc06bf5b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172362/commits/61afcff480ee54adb36f78435180e712bc06bf5b)
- Landed commit: [12ec309f9b0ba17ddc227451d896f70c956d2f48](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12ec309f9b0ba17ddc227451d896f70c956d2f48)

<!-- openclaw-merge:48d5fd99-8335-4dca-8958-0f7d98a74236 -->

The first full UI run observed after this merge exposes seven sidebar failures in [run 38696688519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38696688519), which tested palette PR #171648 against main `2e6c763fad7f9193cdd822248cb576ce58d9f324` (includes this change). The prior scheduled main at `e1dbb564` passed its UI jobs; exact-current-base reproduction is being qualified, so this is a source diagnosis, not yet a completed inherited-failure classification.

- `Control UI session management mocked Gateway E2E > nests spawned sessions (personal pin: false)` and `(personal pin: true)` fail at `session-management.sidebar.e2e.test.ts:137`: initial child count is 4 instead of 0, before the disclosure click.
- `Control UI session management mocked Gateway E2E > keeps the drag source still while promoting a nested conversation with a native pointer` fails at `session-management.promotion.e2e.test.ts:35`: the child is absent after clicking the disclosure. The failure precedes dragging.
- All four `Agent-first sidebar geometry > keeps recursive indicators right-aligned and names readable …` variants fail at `sidebar-agent-first.e2e.test.ts:316`: light/258/pointer, light/334/pointer, dark/286/pointer, light/334/touch. The right-edge differences are 24 px for pointer and 68 px for touch; touch also fails the soft title-fit assertion at line 150.

The geometry differences match this change's new 20 px disclosure column plus 4 px gap; touch additionally reserves 136 px rather than the previous 92 px. Those fixtures still encode the previous layout. The three expansion failures need closer care: this PR promises initially loaded children preserve existing expansion behavior, but `observedChildKeys` can observe an empty parent before its initial child list arrives and then treat hydration as new work. Please preserve that initial-load contract when deciding between a projection fix and fixture changes. No sidebar production code or assertions have been changed in #171648.

Update: one bounded run on clean actual base `2e6c763f` has finished. Both nesting cases and all four geometry variants reproduce the exact CI failure conditions (including both touch assertions). Promotion stopped earlier at the initial-roster readiness prerequisite, so that case is still unattributed. The command selected only these seven cases from the three named files with one worker; no assertion or source change and no repeat run. This confirms the six matching failures on main independently of the palette patch.

The promotion gap is now closed independently by [scheduled main run 38699948035, job 116305821502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38699948035/job/116305821502), at `47b0a1cc`: the same test fails at line 35 with the same 30-second child-visibility timeout. Its completed geometry shard also repeats all four conditions. The earlier local promotion readiness failure remains an inconclusive attempt; it was not rerun. All seven palette-run failures are now accounted for without changing sidebar code or assertions.
